title: 2. Test structural breadth instead of deeper parameter search
hypothesis: Missing task-specific controller logic limits the weakest scanned task, so spreading a fixed rollout budget across independent structures will outperform deeper parameter search within one structure.

prediction.against: baseline: fresh paired single-phase structure with 24 independent parameter candidates
prediction.rationale: Compare four independently generated structures with six candidates each against one structure with 24 candidates, holding each arm's screening budget fixed. Require a mean gain of at least 0.15 and a positive paired block-level t-interval lower bound; tied success is not improvement.

protocol.command: gpu run -- python scripts/compare_generation_modes.py --research-mode structure-breadth --config config/two_lane_search_v2.yaml --scan-dir logs/research/task_scan_s2600 --task-selection lowest-promotion-success --task-tie-break lexicographic --require-scan-success-below 0.80 --block-seeds 2630,2631,2632,2633,2634,2635 --manifest-seeds 2640,2641,2642,2643,2644,2645 --generation-mode single-phase --schema-source existing --seedless --bc-steps 0 --control-structures 1 --control-candidates-per-structure 24 --treatment-structures 4 --treatment-candidates-per-structure 6 --share-anchor-prefix 6 --search-method independent --include-default --selector success-then-progress --screen-cases 0:5 --promotion-cases 10:40 --model gpt-6.1-sol --reasoning-effort high --temperature 1 --max-repair-per-candidate 1 --manifest-dir config/manifests/research/structure_breadth_s2630 --output logs/research/structure_breadth_s2630 --no-promote
code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: add structure-breadth mode; freeze task selection before follow-up generation and do not reuse scanned structures or outcomes as evaluation data. This changes structural breadth, unlike D-014's generator comparison or D-016's selector comparison.

scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: generate four structures per block with identical unchanged prompts; use the first as the control and share its first six candidate evaluations. Each arm screens 24 candidates; the union contains 42. Select one winner per arm and evaluate both on the same 30 fresh cases.

scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: report six block-level paired differences and their t interval; preserve the existing promotion gate and perform no automatic promotion. Budget is 6 × (42 × 5 + 2 × 30) episodes; 48 LLM calls is the ceiling including one correction per slot.
config/manifests/research/structure_breadth_s2630/: add six frozen development manifests and selected-task provenance.
config/experiment_seed_ledger.jsonl: reserve seeds only if the scan qualifies a task. This follow-up needs separate user approval; the implementer must stop the remote afterward.

falsified_by: A paired interval upper bound below 0.15 refutes the predicted gain; an upper bound at or below zero also refutes the directional mechanism. An interval containing zero is inconclusive; the resolving measurement is the paired success difference over additional independent generation blocks on fresh development manifests. Skip execution if the scan has no task below 0.80.
